name: 비디오 노이즈 패턴 분석
description: 비디오에서 조작된 영역을 감지하기 위해 센서 노이즈 패턴과 시간적 일관성을 분석합니다.
useCase: Detecting video manipulation through noise fingerprint inconsistencies across frames
mechanism: Extracts photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) noise patterns from video frames and checks temporal consistency. Manipulated regions disrupt the natural noise pattern, creating detectable boundaries between original and inserted content.
accuracy: Medium-High - 75-87% on video splicing and inpainting
source: Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020) - Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint, IEEE TIFS
algorithm: Noise Residual Extraction + PRNU Estimation + Temporal-Spatial Consistency Map
parameters: Denoising: BM3D variant, PRNU window: 30 frames, Block size: 64x64, Correlation threshold: adaptive
